<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Rip and Tear](/Feats.aspx?ID=5401) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Barbarian" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=18" />
<trait label="Druid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=583" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 56

**Prerequisites**

**Requirements**
Your last action dealt piercing or slashing damage using an [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719) Strike granted by a [morph](/Traits.aspx?ID=657) or [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670) effect.

</column>

---

You've learned to debilitate your enemies in the same way a hunter tears at their prey. Make an [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719) Strike against the same target. If the Strike hits and deals piercing or slashing damage, the target takes an additional 1d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). If you're at least 12th level, increase this to 2d6 persistent bleed damage.
